## Goal

Make the browser page take its layout from the image: load `/api/today`, draw the
image to a canvas, derive the theme with the shared helpers and apply it as CSS
custom properties on the shell that W1-03 serves.

## Scope

- `src/client/sample.ts` (pure, no DOM at module top level):
  - `export function luminanceGrid(rgba: ArrayLike<number>, width: number, height: number, cols: number, rows: number): number[]` returns the row-major mean WCAG luminance per cell.
  - `export function themeFromPixels(rgba: ArrayLike<number>, width: number, height: number): Theme` calls `extractPalette(rgba, 6)`, `luminanceGrid(..., 4, 4)` and `deriveTheme(palette, lums, 4, 4)`.
- `src/client/apply.ts` (pure, structural types only):
  - `export type StyleTarget = { style: { setProperty(name: string, value: string): void }; dataset: Record<string, string | undefined> }`.
  - `export function applyTheme(theme: Theme, target: StyleTarget): void` sets the six custom properties, `dataset.mode` and `dataset.placement`.
  - `export function creditLine(credit: string, licence: string): string`.
- `src/client/main.ts` (browser bootstrap, not imported by tests):
  - fetches `/api/today`, forwarding `?date=` from `location.search`;
  - fills `#date`, `#title`, `#story` and `#credit` using `textContent`;
  - sets `img#art.src`, and on `load` draws the image to a 64x64 canvas, reads `getImageData`, then calls `applyTheme(themeFromPixels(...), document.documentElement)`;
  - if `getImageData` throws, applies `neutralTheme()`.
- `src/client/style.css`:
  - `img#art` is `position: fixed; inset: 0; object-fit: cover`;
  - the text card uses `var(--paper)`, `var(--ink)`, `var(--accent)` and `var(--font)`;
  - `[data-placement]` selectors pin the card to each of the four corners;
  - `transition: 1.2s` applies to `color`, `background-color` and `box-shadow`;
  - a `prefers-reduced-motion` rule sets the transition to `0s`.

## Out of scope

- Threads, layers, day-rollover polling and arrow-key browsing (later chunks).
- Server routes; the shell markup and its element ids are owned by W1-03.

## Done

- `node --test tests/client.test.ts` passes with the four tests in the header. The tests import only `sample.ts` and `apply.ts`.
- Relative imports use `.ts` extensions: `../shared/palette.ts`, `../shared/theme.ts`, `./sample.ts`, `./apply.ts`.
- With `node src/server.ts` running, `http://localhost:3000/` shows the image full-bleed, the title, story and credit line are filled, and `document.documentElement.style` holds all six custom properties.
- `tests/slice.test.ts` still passes unchanged.
